$comment: Phase 4 decommission evidence for the Goobers migration (epic #3838, issue #3839).
This file is the operator-attested snapshot that gates removal of the legacy
ci-recovery/merge-train lifecycle mutation paths. The live source of truth for a lane
owner is its repository variable; this record is the durable, reviewable attestation
that the variable was observed in that state. Update it in a PR as each lane migrates,
as the soak runs, and when the rollback drill completes.

soak.note: Starts only once every PR-lifecycle lane reads `goobers`.

emergencyBridge.note: Set `boundedUntil` when the soak starts; the bridge is removed only after the drill passes.
